Thanks — reviewed the attachments and chatted with finance. Recommendation and decision: APPROVE the concession with the following guardrails.

1) Credit mechanics: $25k issued as prepaid usage credits applied to the Mapsense account on contract start; credits expire at pilot end (90 days) and are non-refundable.
2) Rate concession: 15% off list for the pilot only, with published fallback pricing after pilot end. No auto-rollback to concessional pricing in production.
3) Acceptance criteria: at 6 weeks Mapsense must demonstrate a reproducible latency profile (p50/p95), pass a basic throughput test (sustained 12k tokens/minute for 15 mins), and share the initial integration metrics doc. Meeting these will trigger a dedicated review for an expansion discount (not automatic).
4) SLA note: we will include a best-effort latency target in the SOW for the pilot; full SLA reserved for committed contracts.

I authorize Sergio to proceed and finalize SOW/DocuSign with Mapsense under these terms. Lauren — please confirm accounting flow and that the credits will be tracked as deferred revenue.

Aditya Rao
VP Finance | Redwood Inference
